claim: Weight stroke re-resolves the rig per dab with the joint name captured at press, so a mid-gesture rig change commits edits to two rigs

triage.scenario: Selected or externally supplied rig changes during a weight stroke; the pending map collects edits from both rigs and commits them as one

claim: sceneReach uses the larger world extent as a circular radius, so under nonuniform zoom, joint picking and the brush overreach what is drawn on screen

triage.scenario: View with unequal axis scales; input along the more magnified axis reaches beyond the displayed dot or brush ring
triage.cause: scalar world radius for an anisotropic screen-space reach

claim: Removing a joint leaves `data.joint` bindings naming it, and the next bone drawn reuses the name and takes them over
Active joint is stored by name only, so switching rigs silently selects another rig's joint with the same name

triage.scenario: Select a different rig whose auto-generated joint names repeat; the bone and weight actions act on its matching joint
triage.cause: joint identity keyed by name without rig

claim: The overlays don't repaint when a consumer-supplied `selection` or `rig` thunk changes
The weight brush paints only where the pointer was sampled, so a fast drag leaves gaps
